watch.note: each watch day writes a short watch file (Investigator only); no alert, no Coordinator, template report

routing_thresholds.method: call budget (label-free): false calls on Normal days <= B per patient-week
notes: theta is a fraction of each detector's own alert threshold (r = p / tau, max over detectors); it is a quantile of r on the Normal days, so it depends on those days and on the detectors' score scale.
patient-level bootstrap over 20 patients: wide intervals mean few patients drive the tail of the r distribution
Labels.csv provenance is unverified; the label columns are a weak sensitivity check, not validation (no claim that near-miss days are more often clinically relevant).
r is a routing score, not a probability; nothing labels 'the right agents', so the budget is a stated preference (how many near-miss watch files per patient-week), not an estimate of harm.

triage.authority_tools: reads detector outputs; writes status and opens the case; the ONLY part that decides
triage.timing_failure: synchronous, on the alert path; rules, cannot hang

investigator.goal: explain WHY the status was given
investigator.authority_tools: bounded tool loop over the person's own history (<= 7 checks); writes the case file; cannot change the status
investigator.timing_failure: after the alert is queued; may fail without losing anything

coordinator.goal: make sure someone acts on an alert
coordinator.authority_tools: owns the alert lifecycle, wall-clock timers, second contact, care tasks; cannot suppress the first alert
coordinator.timing_failure: long-running; days, not milliseconds; state survives a restart

report.goal: say it in plain words for people
report.authority_tools: LLM + retrieval tools + non-LLM validator; writes text only
report.timing_failure: slow, rate-limited, can be down; template fallback

designs.name: 1 agent (monolith)
designs.description: one loop: score, decide, investigate, write, chase acknowledgements

criteria.alert path independent of slow work: no: the alert waits behind whatever the loop is doing (an LLM call, a retry)

designs.name: 2 agents (decide + write)
designs.description: Triage; Report (investigation and alert follow-up folded into one of them)

criteria.timers (ack / escalation) kept apart fro: no: a day-long acknowledgement timer sits inside a per-day writer

designs.name: 4 agents (ECHOS)
designs.description: Triage; Case Investigator; Care Coordinator; Report

designs.name: 6 agents
designs.description: as 4, plus a separate Validator agent and a separate Escalation agent
